text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 大家好,欢迎收听《轻松学英语》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收聽《輕鬆學英語》。

text: In this podcast,
we have real conversations
in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语来帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語來幫助你學習。

text: I'm Beth.
And I'm Georgie.
You can find a video version of this podcast and a worksheet
zh: 你可以找到这个播客的视频版本和一份练习册
zh_hant: 你可以找到這個播客的影片版本和一份練習冊

text: to help you learn on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 在我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com上帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 在我們的網站bbclearningenglish.com上幫助你學習。

text: Hello, Georgie.
How are you today?
I'm very well, thank you, Beth.
How are you?
I'm very good, very good.
Today we are talking about mess .
zh: 今天我们来聊聊“混乱”这个话题。
zh_hant: 今天我們來聊聊“混亂”這個話題。

text: Now, mess is when something is untidy.
zh: “乱”指的是东西不整齐、杂乱无章。
zh_hant: “亂”指的是東西不整齊、雜亂無章。

text: I left my house
in a bit of a mess this morning.
Oh dear, Beth.
That's not very good.
I slept in a bit too long.
My kitchen is a mess .
There are pans on the side.
I don't want to think about it really.
zh: 我真的不想去想这件事。
zh_hant: 我真的不想去想這件事。

text: Beth, that sounds disgusting.
Are you a messy person in general?
zh: 你一般是个邋遢的人吗?
zh_hant: 你一般是個邋遢的人嗎?

text: I like things to be clean,
but if there is a bit of mess , I'm OK with it.
zh: 不过如果有一点乱，我也没关系。
zh_hant: 不過如果有一點亂，我也沒關係。

text: But I try to sort out the mess
zh: 但我试着把这一团糟整理清楚
zh_hant: 但我試著把這一團糟整理清楚

text: as soon as I can.
But you know
how sometimes you cook dinner, for example,
zh: 比如说,你有时候做晚饭,
zh_hant: 比如說,你有時候做晚飯,

text: and then I don't do the washing up immediately
because I want to eat my food hot.
So I will eat, relax for a bit,
and then I will clean the kitchen.
Do you have like a rule in your house
for the length of time you can leave the washing up?
zh: 取决于你能把要洗的碗放多久
zh_hant: 取決於你能把要洗的碗放多久

text: Like, does it have to be that evening
zh: 就是,一定要是那天晚上吗
zh_hant: 就是,一定要是那天晚上嗎

text: or can it be the next day?
I like it to be that evening, but it's not always that evening,
zh: 我希望是那天晚上,但并不总是那天晚上。
zh_hant: 我希望是那天晚上,但並不總是那天晚上。

text: which I don't like.
What about you in your house?
Is it tidy ?
Is it messy ?
It's usually quite tidy because I live with two other people.
zh: 因为我和另外两个人一起住,所以家里通常都挺整洁的。
zh_hant: 因為我和另外兩個人一起住,所以家裡通常都挺整潔的。

text: So we all try to be considerate
zh: 我们都尽量为他人着想
zh_hant: 我們都儘量為他人著想

text: with the shared spaces.
So, yeah.
And my room, I try to tidy every few days.
zh: 我的房间,我每隔几天就会整理一次。
zh_hant: 我的房間,我每隔幾天就會整理一次。

text: So, yeah.
That sounds quite tidy .
Beth, do you have a favourite job to do around the house?
zh: 贝丝,你在家里有最喜欢做的家务吗?
zh_hant: 貝絲,你在家裡有最喜歡做的家務嗎?

text: Or a least favourite job?
zh: 你最不喜欢做的工作呢?
zh_hant: 你最不喜歡做的工作呢?

text: I have a least favourite job
zh: 我最不喜欢做的一件工作
zh_hant: 我最不喜歡做的一件工作

text: and that is washing up.
I hate washing the dishes,
but we have a dishwasher so I use the dishwasher.
zh: 不过我们有洗碗机，所以我用洗碗机。
zh_hant: 不過我們有洗碗機，所以我用洗碗機。

text: But there are some things, like some pans
zh: 但有些东西,比如一些平底锅
zh_hant: 但有些東西,比如一些平底鍋

text: that I should wash up.
So I sometimes do them,
but my husband does them quite a lot.
zh: 不过我丈夫经常做这些事。
zh_hant: 不過我丈夫經常做這些事。

text: Is there any way that you make washing
zh: 洗碗有什么办法可以吗?
zh_hant: 洗碗有什麼辦法可以嗎?

text: up a more enjoyable activity?
There is.
I put music on, I put a song on,
zh: 我放了音乐,放了一首歌,
zh_hant: 我放了音樂,放了一首歌,

text: and I make sure I've finished by the end of the song,
zh: 我会确保在歌曲结束前完成。
zh_hant: 我會確保在歌曲結束前完成。

text: and it just makes me happy because I can just sing along
zh: 这让我很开心,因为我可以跟着唱
zh_hant: 這讓我很開心,因為我可以跟著唱

text: and not focus on hating washing up.
zh: 不要老想着讨厌洗碗这件事。
zh_hant: 不要老想著討厭洗碗這件事。

text: And it's not even that bad.
I quite like tidying my room
because I find it quite satisfying,
zh: 因为我觉得这挺让人满足的,
zh_hant: 因為我覺得這挺讓人滿足的,

text: because you, you end up with a good result at the end.
zh: 因为你,你最终会得到一个好结果。
zh_hant: 因為你,你最終會得到一個好結果。

text: You have a tidy space to relax
zh: 你有一个整洁的空间可以放松
zh_hant: 你有一個整潔的空間可以放鬆

text: in and spend time in.
zh: 居住并在其中消磨时光的地方
zh_hant: 居住並在其中消磨時光的地方

text: That's actually on my to-do list at the moment.
zh: 这正好在我目前的待办事项清单上。
zh_hant: 這正好在我目前的待辦事項清單上。

text: Later I'm going to go home and tidy my room.
zh: 我等会儿要回家整理房间。
zh_hant: 我等會兒要回家整理房間。

text: I do need to hoover,
so hoovering is on my to-do list .
zh: 所以吸尘是我待办事项清单上的一项。
zh_hant: 所以吸塵是我待辦事項清單上的一項。

text: A to-do list is a list of jobs
zh: 待办事项清单是一份工作列表。
zh_hant: 待辦事項清單是一份工作列表。

text: that you need to do.
So I do need to hoover.
But I'm not sure if I'll do it today.
zh: 不过我不确定今天会不会做这件事。
zh_hant: 不過我不確定今天會不會做這件事。

text: I might do it tomorrow.
We also used the adjective
messy to describe a dirty or untidy place.
zh: 用来形容肮脏或凌乱的地方。
zh_hant: 用來形容骯髒或凌亂的地方。

text: We can also describe a person as messy ,
zh: 也可以用messy来形容一个人邋遢。
zh_hant: 也可以用messy來形容一個人邋遢。

text: which means that they don't clean
things and they often make a mess .
zh: 这些东西常常把事情搞得一团糟。
zh_hant: 這些東西常常把事情搞得一團糟。

text: The opposite of messy is tidy .
So a place, like your bedroom, or Georgie's
zh: 比如某个地方,像是你的卧室,或者乔治的卧室
zh_hant: 比如某個地方,像是你的臥室,或者喬治的臥室

text: bedroom,
can be tidy , and you can also be described as a tidy person.
zh: 可以很整洁,你也可以被形容为一个整洁的人。
zh_hant: 可以很整潔,你也可以被形容為一個整潔的人。

text: That's if you usually clean things
zh: 这是指你平时会打扫的情况
zh_hant: 這是指你平時會打掃的情況

text: and don't make a mess .
And a to-do list is a list of jobs
zh: 待办事项清单就是一份工作清单
zh_hant: 待辦事項清單就是一份工作清單

text: you need to
do – sometimes jobs around the house, like cleaning.
zh: 有时候会做一些家务,比如打扫卫生。
zh_hant: 有時候會做一些家務,比如打掃衛生。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 本期《Real Easy English》就到这里。
zh_hant: 本期《Real Easy English》就到這裡。

text: If you've enjoyed this episode
about mess and want to learn more vocabulary
zh: 关于混乱并想学更多词汇
zh_hant: 關於混亂並想學更多詞彙

text: for cleaning,
Georgie has made a video – Phrasal verbs
zh: 乔治(Georgie)制作了一个视频——短语动词
zh_hant: 喬治(Georgie)製作了一個影片——短語動詞

text: for housework.
Find it on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 请到我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上查找。
zh_hant: 請到我們的網站 bbclearningenglish.com 上查詢。

text: And don't forget to try the worksheet on our website to test what you've learned.
zh: 别忘了去我们网站上试试练习题,检验一下你学到的内容。
zh_hant: 別忘了去我們網站上試試練習題,檢驗一下你學到的內容。

text: We'll be back next week with another conversation in easy English.
zh: 我们下周将带来另一期简单英语对话节目。
zh_hant: 我們下週將帶來另一期簡單英語對話節目。

text: See you then.
Bye!
